methods.name: Correlation test: Pearson one-sided intervals, Spearman exact and Edgeworth p-values and S, Kendall tau-b with the exact T or the tie-corrected z
methods.reference: stats::cor.test (R 4.3.3 defaults: Spearman exact = n < 1290 without ties, by enumeration for n <= 9 and by the AS 89 Edgeworth series above, t approximation with ties or n >= 1290; Kendall exact = n < 50 without ties, otherwise tau-b with the tie-corrected variance and continuity = FALSE)
quantities: Pearson r, t, df, p (two-sided, less, greater), 95% and 90% two-sided intervals, one-sided intervals with the open bound -1 or 1
Spearman rho, S = (n^3 - n)(1 - rho)/6, p (two-sided, less, greater) on the exact, Edgeworth and t paths, perfect monotone data in both directions
Kendall tau-b, T (exact path) or z (normal path), the statistic's name, p (two-sided, less, greater)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md by n: r, rho, tau Tol::coef(n); t, z, S, interval bounds Tol::stat(n); p Tol::p_value(n) (abs 1e-12, so R's 0 from the clamped Edgeworth tail and p2a's tail below 1e-12 compare equal); T and df exact

methods.name: Descriptive statistics of numeric columns: count, mean, sd, min, type-7 quartiles and median, max over the present values

methods.name: Kernel density estimate: R's binned FFT grid for any number of points, seven kernels with bw as the kernel's standard deviation, bw.nrd0 with its fallbacks
methods.reference: stats::density.default (R 4.3.3: linear binning on 2^k >= max(n, 512) points over [from - 4 bw, to + 4 bw], FFT convolution, approx onto seq(from, to, length.out = n)); stats::bw.nrd0; the exact kernel sum mean(K((x0 - x)/bw))/bw with R's kernels for the unbinned path
quantities: x and y on grids of 50, 100, 512 and 1000 points, with and without from/to, Gaussian kernel
y for the epanechnikov, rectangular, triangular, biweight, cosine and optcosine kernels
y with infinite values (mass scaled by the finite share) and n
default bandwidth (bw.nrd0) and the density at it, including IQR = 0, sd = 0 and x[1] = 0
exact kernel sums of the unbinned path (kde_* keys)
density of the descriptive_na columns at the stats_density defaults (n = 512)
